pages.text: The Akaishi Crystal is the tech line's $(bold)base currency and fuel$(0): recipes need it, power generation needs it, and refining can't do without it.$(br2)$(bold)First craft:$(0) fill a 3×3 grid with 9 crystals to get 1 $(bold)Raw Akaishi Block$(0) (and you can always break it back into 9).$(br2)Don't waste raw blocks: they're the purifier's $(4)raw material and fuel$(0), and the generator's second-tier fuel — $(e)one block outburns ten crystals$(0).

Akaishi Essence is the "refined intermediate": feed a raw block or crystal block into the $(l:akaishi:purifier)Purifier$(/l) and it squeezes essence out. You can concentrate it into two $(4)premium materials$(0):$(li)9 essence → Compressed Akaishi Essence: used in upgrade templates and fusion parts$(li)9 essence → Compressed Akaishi Essence Block: reversible, the building block of the Equipment Forger and reactor/fusion shells$(br2)$(bold)Fuel climbs the same ladder$(0): essence → compressed essence → compressed block are tiers 3-5 of the generator's fuel list — $(4)refine one more step, reload ten fewer times$(0).

Three more members of the crystal family:$(li)$(bold)Akaishi Crystal Block$(0): 9 crystals pressed in the Compressor (reversible); feed it to a purifier or matrix for $(4)4 essence$(0)$(li)Akaishi Crystal Geode: sprouts clusters over time, and the Aggregator can tier it up$(li)Akaishi Crystal Cluster: mined for 1-2 essence$(br2)"Grow + harvest" with geodes is your mid-game crystal farm — see the Catalyst in the Advanced chapter.

Reading order: mine crystals from ore → squeeze blocks into essence at the Purifier → concentrate essence into premium materials → save up and condense an Akaishi Ingot at the Aggregator. Want a shortcut? The Compressor's dust-to-block and crystal-to-crystal-block recipes plug right into this chain.
